name: Lehi Sheet Metal, Corp.
old_description: LEHI Sheet Metal has been producing quality precision sheet metal products for over 46 years. We are committed to giving our customers the best quality, service, and on-time delivery.
about:
Lehi Sheet Metal Corporation was founded in September 1978 in Ashland, Massachusetts, and relocated to Westborough in 1980. The company became a legacy family-owned business in 2018 when longtime general manager Darren Bullen, son of the previous owner, acquired it. In January 2020, Lori Bullen joined as CEO, bringing 27 years of experience from the U.S. Postal Service and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification.

The 50,000-square-foot Westborough facility houses a full-service precision sheet metal shop, an in-house paint, powder coat, and silkscreen operation (Galaxy Coatings, acquired in 2007), and a CNC machine shop (East Coast Machining Solutions, added in 2025). Core processes include laser cutting, forming, press brake forming, welding, machining, hardware insertion, riveting, powder coating, silk screening, and wet paint. The company focuses on prototype and low-volume production runs.

Lehi serves industries including robotics, medical devices, automotive, electronics, telecommunications, oil and gas, energy systems, water systems, start-ups, marine, agricultural, instrumentation, solar systems, and aerospace. Customers range from large OEMs to early-stage ventures across New England and nationally.

The company emphasizes a “one-stop-shop” model with all fabrication, finishing, and machining under one roof, supported by in-house tooling lists for turret punch presses that help reduce design costs. Lehi cites a greater-than-99% quality rate, an average employee tenure of 16 years, and adherence to ISO 9001:2015, ITAR, and AS9100 standards as key differentiators.
